posts.title: Debian Cambridge mini-conference 2026
posts.description: I participated in the 2026 Mini-debconf in Cambridge a couple of weeks ago. It's a time and place where I get to meet many of my British friends. This year I gave three full talks: Ambient CI: building untrusted software Early days of Linux Obnam backup software, tranquillo The talks were recorded. posts.title: Obnam community
posts.description: Obnam is going to be an encrypting, de-duplicating, secure, and fast backup software implementation that's easy and convenient to use. I've been developing a new generation of Obnam for a couple of years now. So far I have mostly been exploring architectural and implementation design choices on my own.
